newsitem.title: CANADA: Band-Ore up on anticipation of results.
newsitem.headline: Band-Ore up on anticipation of results.

text.p: Band-Ore Resources Ltd's shares bounced up in morning trading on Monday as investors anticipated more drill results expected this week.
Shares in the Toronto-based exploration company rose C$0.65 to C$12.90.
Assays from up to 12 holes will likely be made public in the next couple of days, Band-Ore spokesman Jonathan Armes said in an interview.
The next batch of drilling will bring the total number of holes to 90 at the company's property in the Timmins area in Northern Ontario, Armes said.
"The play has heated up because other companies have had some interests in the same area," said one analyst.
The market is especially interested in drilling from a new discovery zone, he said. One hole from the zone has already been reported and this week's results should shed more light on the area.
